component.name: SROVA
component.summary: Headless audiophile player with bit-perfect output support

description.p: SROVA is a headless audiophile music player for Local Music, TIDAL, Qobuz and Internet Radio. It is designed for high-quality native playback, dedicated audio systems and browser-based control.
TIDAL and Qobuz share SROVA's online-provider source with provider-aware search, navigation, Radio, playlists and queue behavior.
Spotify Connect can optionally be exposed through Spotify's official Soloist endpoint. That external endpoint is separate from SROVA native playback sources.

screenshot.caption: SROVA web interface for local, online-provider and radio playback

description.p: RC1 packaging update: SROVA now installs as a headless service and the desktop Open action shows the SROVA browser access popup instead of launching a legacy desktop app.
This build includes SROVA branding, support contact metadata, AppStream installer details, and improved side-by-side behavior with older installations.
